description: This Java class implements a servlet filter that clears specified cookies (by default, the session cookie JSESSIONID) when a user logs out. It is part of the OpenMRS web application, specifically for handling session cookie cleanup.

classes.name: CookieClearingFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that clears cookies such as session cookies when a user logs out, configurable via runtime properties.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the filtering method to check whether cookies should be cleared based on request state and runtime properties, then clears specified cookies if conditions are met.
